descriptions.text: MintRisesPrices on BNBChain suffered a reentrancy attack, resulting in a loss of approximately $59,000.

On July 2, 2024, the MintRisesPrices protocol on BNB Chain suffered a reentrancy attack, resulting in a loss of approximately $59,000. The exploit led to a protocol relaunch under a new smart contract, but detailed technical and transaction-level evidence remains unavailable. Vulnerable protocol logic enabled reentrant calls, allowing an attacker to drain assets through repeated interactions with contract functions without proper state update checks.
